name: Shunichi Maki
bio: Shunichi Maki (真木 駿一, Maki Shun'ichi, born June 25, 1990) is a Japanese voice actor from Saitama Prefecture. He is currently freelance and previously was an associate member of Axel One from April 2015 to March 31, 2024. His blood type is A and a he is 175 cm tall. His hobbies are sports, mahjong and reading. His special skills are rugby, baseball and soccer.
